changelog: A REAL FIX FOR BIG ARMIES. If your roster grew past eight units, the extras could be planted inside rock, water or off the map entirely — the muster only ever checked map bounds, never terrain. The first eight always landed safely (the ground around your base is cleared), which is why this went unnoticed; across 120 seeds a 16-strong roster stranded up to 8 units. Every level now puts the whole army down on real ground, however many you bring. THE SPIRE is a sealed rock chamber rather than an open field, and widened so the walls cost you no fighting room. BIG CREATURES — the Nightwalker, the Spire's heart, the four-tile commanders — now draw as ONE token across their whole footprint instead of a mosaic, and cover comes from the tile you actually struck: hit the half standing in forest and the forest protects it, even though the rest of it is in the open. END TURN GLOWS once you genuinely have nothing left to do — which accounts for free cards and a ready Command Power, not just an empty Command Point bar.
